title: Agent Skills Well-Known Index (v1)
description: Manifest published at /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json so that external agents can discover and load skills via the well-known URL convention. Field shape and minimal contract are aligned with the @easbot/plugin WellKnownProvider.fetchAllSkills parser.

$schema.description: Absolute URL of this schema document. MUST match the value of `$id`.

version.description: Protocol version of this index document. MUST be the literal string `1.0.0` for v1.

endpoint.description: Default well-known URL where this index is served. Convention value: `/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json`.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (with timezone) marking when the index was generated.

source.description: Provenance metadata for the underlying skill tree.

type.description: Source transport type. v1 only supports `git`.

ref.description: Git ref (branch / tag / commit SHA) the index was generated from.

path.description: Relative path (POSIX, starting with `./`) to the skill tree root inside the index bundle.

skills.description: Ordered list of skills exposed by this index. Order is not significant for discovery but should be stable for deterministic output.

name.description: hyphen-case skill name. MUST match the directory name and the SKILL.md frontmatter `name`.

category.description: Skill category. v1 vocabulary: `builtin` (core EASBot skills) or `tools` (general-purpose utilities).

description.description: Third-person description starting with `该技能应在 …` (zh) / `Use this skill when …` (en). Maximum 1024 characters.

version.description: Skill version (semver recommended). Falls back to `0.1.0` if not declared in SKILL.md frontmatter.

sourceUrl.description: Relative path (POSIX, starting with `./`) to the skill's SKILL.md inside the well-known bundle, e.g. `./skills/builtin/eas-skill-using/SKILL.md`.

installName.description: Install identifier in `<owner>/<repo>:<skill-name>` form, matching the @easbot/agent-skills package convention.

tags.description: Optional hyphen-case keywords carried over from SKILL.md frontmatter for search / filtering.

metadata.description: Optional free-form metadata for fields not covered by the top-level schema (e.g. `mode`, `composition`, `behavior`). Values are JSON-native.
